metaTitle: Anime Cabinet Terms | Custom Anime Portrait Commissions
description: Read Anime Cabinet terms for custom anime portraits, artwork previews, revisions, delivery, payments, copyright, cancellations and customer responsibilities.

bodySections.heading: 1. About Anime Cabinet
paragraphs: These Anime Cabinet terms apply when you browse animecabinet.com, place an order, or request a custom anime portrait commission online. Anime Cabinet connects customers with human artists who hand-draw original portraits inspired by anime and cartoon visual language. Our work does not impersonate or reproduce copyrighted characters as official artwork.

bodySections.heading: 2. Orders and commission briefs
paragraphs: To order, provide clear reference images and a useful brief. Include the number of people or pets, preferred background, pose, clothing, colour choices, facial details, framing, and the style you want. You may request a custom anime portrait from photo, a custom anime portrait canvas design, or a cartoon-inspired alternative. References should belong to you or be used with permission.

Terms such as ‘anime style’, ‘Ghibli-inspired’, ‘shonen’, ‘chibi’, ‘wanted poster’, and ‘cartoon portrait’ describe creative direction. They do not mean that we will copy a specific copyrighted character, logo, artist, or exact frame. For example, a custom anime portrait Naruto request can inspire an original ninja-themed character rather than reproduce Naruto himself. You can also explore our [Naruto portraits](/portraits/naruto) and other available style options before ordering.

bodySections.heading: 3. Artist previews and revisions
paragraphs: A human artist creates each portrait; we do not sell AI-generated images or AI filters. You will receive a preview within 72 hours under standard delivery. Unlimited free revisions are included so you can request reasonable changes to the approved brief, such as adjustments to hair, expression, colours, clothing, or background.

Revision requests should be specific and submitted through the order communication channel. A substantially new concept, additional subjects, or a completely different brief may require a new order or a quoted adjustment. Work begins from the information supplied at checkout, so please check your details carefully.

bodySections.heading: 4. Pricing, payment and delivery
paragraphs: The price of a custom anime or cartoon portrait depends on factors such as subject count, product format, detail, and selected options. The applicable price is the amount displayed before payment or confirmed by Anime Cabinet. Be cautious of listings advertised as ‘custom anime portrait free’: they may be previews, trials, or separate services and are not an Anime Cabinet order unless clearly confirmed on our website.

Standard previews are supplied within 72 hours. Any estimated final delivery time depends on the product and the time needed for revisions, printing, or shipping. Customers seeking a custom anime portrait Australia order should review the delivery information shown at checkout, including any applicable shipping charges, taxes, or import costs.

bodySections.heading: 5. Copyright and permitted use
paragraphs: Anime Cabinet retains ownership of the original artwork unless a written agreement states otherwise. You receive permission to use your purchased portrait for personal purposes, including gifts, home display, and personal social media. Commercial use, resale, merchandise, advertising, or incorporation into a business identity requires written permission.

Customers must not submit unlawful, hateful, sexually exploitative, or infringing material. We may decline a request that violates these terms or the rights of another person or rights holder. Anime Cabinet may display completed work in a portfolio only where permitted by the applicable order preferences.

bodySections.heading: 6. Cancellations, refunds and customer information
paragraphs: Because commissions are made to order, cancellation and refund eligibility may change once an artist has started work or a physical product has entered production. Contact us as soon as possible if you need to cancel or correct an order. We will assess the request under applicable consumer law and the stage of production.

You are responsible for accurate contact, delivery, reference, and personalisation details. Anime Cabinet is not responsible for delays or errors caused by incomplete or incorrect information, although we will work with you to resolve reasonable issues.

bodySections.heading: 7. Common questions about these terms
paragraphs: How do Anime Cabinet terms differ from standard anime and cartoon commission terms? Our terms specifically cover hand-drawn human artwork, original fan-art-inspired characters, a preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions. A custom anime portrait differs from a cartoon portrait mainly in visual language: anime commonly uses stylised eyes, linework, expressions, and proportions, while cartoon direction can be broader and more exaggerated.

How long does a commission take? You receive a standard preview within 72 hours; the final timeline depends on revisions, format, and delivery. What references should you provide? Use well-lit, high-resolution images showing faces, hair, clothing, poses, and any important details. Can an artist turn a real person into anime style? Yes, we can create an original anime-style portrait from an appropriate reference photo. For questions about an order or these Anime Cabinet terms, contact us before purchasing.
